blocks.title: Solids
blocks.text: Solids (thos) woh madde hain jo sakht aur mazboot hain aur muqarrar shakal aur muqarrar hajm rakhte hain.
Solid banane wale atoms, ions aur molecules qareeb qareeb bhare hain aur mazboot jorne wali (cohesive) forces se jure hain; solid ke ajza atoms, ions ya molecules be-tarteeb harkat nahi kar sakte.

blocks.prompt: Solid ke zarraat ki harkat ka liquid aur gas se muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: Solid mein zarraat mazboot cohesive forces se apni jagah band hain aur sirf muqarrar jagahon ke gird laraz sakte hain. Liquid mein woh rabte mein rehte hain magar be-tarteeb taur par ek doosre ke paas se guzarte hain, to liquid behta hai. Gas mein woh zyada tar khali jagah mein azad urte hain.

items: Solids sakht aur mazboot hain, muqarrar shakal aur hajm ke saath; un ke qareeb bhare zarraat mazboot cohesive forces se jure hain aur be-tarteeb harkat nahi kar sakte.
